newsitem.title: LEBANON: Israeli soldiers kill one guerrilla in Lebanon.
newsitem.headline: Israeli soldiers kill one guerrilla in Lebanon.

text.p: Israeli soldiers fired artillery shells at a group of guerrillas in south Lebanon on Wednesday, killing one guerrilla, pro-Israeli militia sources said.

The Israeli gunners fired at the guerrillas immediately after the fighters ambushed members of an Israeli patrol near Beit Yahoun, on the edge of Israel's occupation zone in south Lebanon, the South Lebanon Army (SLA) militia sources said.
One guerrilla was killed as a result of the shelling, they added.
In Beirut, the pro-Iranian Hizbollah (Party of God) said its guerrillas attacked a group of Israeli soldiers with machineguns and rocket-propelled grenades at Beit Yahoun, scoring direct hits.
A spokesman for the group said he had no information whether any of the guerrillas were killed or wounded.

Hizbollah (Party of God) leads a guerrilla war against Israeli and SLA forces in a bid to oust them from the 15-km (nine miles)-wide south Lebanon occupation zone set up to stop cross-border raids on northern Israel.
